This [[Gender|female]] individual was the '''grandmother''' of the [[krill farmer]] [[Caben]]. She lived with a [[Unidentified human tribe|tribe]] in a [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|village]] on [[Sorgan]] prior to the fall of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Along with her [[Caben's grandfather|husband]], she was among the farmers who first seeded the ponds to attract the [[Krill (creature)|krill]] that sustained the village. Generations later, Caben continued to work as a krill farmer in the village.<ref name="Chapter 4" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|4}}</ref> when [[Din Djarin|The Mandalorian]] and [[Carasynthia Dune]] urged the tribe to abandon the village due to attacks by a [[Klatooinian]] [[Klatooinian raiders|tribe]], Caben insisted they could not leave, evoking the memory of his grandparents seeding the krill ponds years prior.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caben's grandfather was mentioned in [[Chapter 4: Sanctuary]],<ref name="Chapter 4" /> the fourth episode of [[The Mandalorian Season One|the first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 29]], [[2019]] exclusively on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Airdate">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1]|archivedate=20210623202717}}</ref>
